{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(sales.dtypes)
print(sales.head())

# Confirm the -1 sentinel in customer_age
print(f"Number of -1 values in customer_age: {(sales['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Compute mean age excluding -1 (missing data)
mean_age = sales.loc[sales['customer_age'] != -1, 'customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age (excluding -1): {mean_age}")"}
